subject: Connecting on CLN3 (Batten Disease) Research
body:
Dear Beyond Batten Disease Foundation team,

My name is Maria, and I lead a patient group for CLN3.

Given our shared focus on CLN3, I believe there may be valuable opportunities for our communities to learn from each other's experiences and efforts.

Would you be open to a brief introductory call in the coming weeks to share updates and explore whether there are ways we might support each other's work going forward?

Thank you for considering this, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Maria
Patient Group Leader
